```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Illuminate\View\Component;
use Livewire\WithEventListeners;

class TagEditComponent extends Component
{
    public $tag;
    public $selectedTagId;
    public $newTagName;

    use WithEventListeners;

    protected $listeners = [
        'updateTag' => 'handleUpdateTag',
        'deleteTag' => 'handleDeleteTag'
    ];

    public function mount($tagId)
    {
        $this->tag = $tagId ? Tag::find($tagId) : null;
        $this->selectedTagId = $tagId ?? null;
    }

    public function save()
    {
        if ($this->tag) {
            $this->tag->name = $this->newTagName;
            $this->tag->save();
        } else {
            Tag::create(['name' => $this->newTagName]);
        }
        $this->emit('tagSaved');
    }

    public function delete()
    {
        if ($this->tag) {
            $this->tag->delete();
            $this->emit('tagDeleted');
        }
    }

    public function updateTag($tagName)
    {
        $this->newTagName = $tagName;
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.tag-edit-component');
    }
}
```
